text.title: ui-ux-design.md Template Output Contract
text.summary: The design-doc this methodology produces: `features/in-progress/F0NN-slug/ui-ux-design.md` with six sections in fixed order. The JSON Schema below is the machine-checkable view of that file; the subagent MUST satisfy it before returning to the caller.

required.field: what the user is trying to accomplish, in one sentence
coarse description of element placement; a screenshot or wireframe is allowed but not required
one entry per state: empty, loading, error, success, disabled — each describing the visible affordance
exactly five rows N1, N3, N4, N5, N6; each row: heuristic, finding, fix-or-noted-OK
exact strings for button labels, error messages, empty-state text, success messages

forbidden.pattern: a Nielsen row for N2, N7, N8, N9 or N10
fewer than five Nielsen rows, or a heuristic listed twice
a States table missing any of empty / loading / error / success / disabled
a section omitted instead of filled with "n/a" and a reason
sections out of the fixed order
ui-ux-design.md filed for a feature with no rendered surface

allowed-transformations.transformation: Fill a section that genuinely has nothing to say with "n/a" plus a reason.
Replace the Layout prose with a screenshot or wireframe reference.
Record "noted OK" as the fix column when the audit row finds nothing.

list.item: Six sections present, in order; nothing omitted, "n/a" rows carry a reason
States table has all five rows, each describing the visible affordance
Nielsen audit has exactly N1, N3, N4, N5, N6 — no other rows
Norman audit has affordance and feedback rows
Copy & microcopy holds exact strings, not placeholders
The feature actually renders or modifies a visible element — otherwise readiness.md item 7 says "no UI impact" and this file does not exist

text.reference: Fillable Markdown template with the six sections and audit-row stubs.
